limit_mechanism.how: Withdrawals at or above lockedThreshold (4,000 WETH; 2,000,000 USDC) are locked for manual unlock; daily limit 4,500 WETH and 2,500,000 USDC for unlocked withdrawals; high-tier threshold 1,000 WETH and 1,000,000 USDC (values read at the block before the first release). Each release was sized just below the lock threshold (3,996.09 ETH; 1,998,046.88 USDC), capping the outflow at about 12M USD of a bridge holding over 850M USD; daily usage after the ETH release was about 4,100 of 4,500 WETH.
